checks.detail: Slim base, all packages justified (git/tmux/strace required by Harbor, ffmpeg/libgl1/libglib2.0-0 by opencv+moviepy), apt cache cleaned, build-time reference generation avoids large files in git.
Contains only solve.sh (with toolchain validation) and scene.py; scene.py matches source_scene.py as expected for the oracle.

Every section serves a clear purpose: mandatory lockdown, source-level anti-cheat grep, clean-room restore from pristine tarball, strace-wrapped agent-user execution, and scorer invocation outside strace.
reasons: useful: source grep for file-reading/subprocess patterns (task-specific — agent must write algorithmic code, not extract frames)
useful: clean-room wipe+restore from pristine tarball (prevents any agent artifacts from influencing scorer re-run)
useful: pkill -9 -u agent before strace (kills lingering background processes)
useful: strace -f wrapping agent execution (prevents background processes from outliving the render)
useful: symlink check on output.mp4 (prevents agent from symlinking to reference)

checks.detail: No files exceed 30MB; reference.mp4 is generated at Docker build time from source_scene.py, keeping the repo lean.
All files serve clear purposes with no dead code or stale configs; workspace stub, pyproject.toml, and uv.lock are minimal and necessary.
